# Contributing

Contributions are welcome!

We appreciate you taking the time to contribute to the PaySimple PHP SDK. Please review the following guidelines to ensure a smooth and effective contribution process.

## How to Contribute

1.  **Fork the Repository:** Start by forking the [main repository](https://github.com/juliocapuano/paysimple_sdk) to your GitHub account.
2.  **Create a Branch:** Create a new branch in your forked repository for your changes. Choose a descriptive branch name (e.g., `feature/add-new-endpoint`, `bugfix/fix-validation-issue`).
3.  **Make Your Changes:** Implement your feature, bug fix, or improvement. Ensure your code follows the existing coding style and conventions.
4.  **Write Tests:** If you are adding new functionality or fixing a bug, please include relevant unit tests. This helps ensure the stability and correctness of the codebase.
5.  **Ensure Tests Pass:** Run the test suite to make sure all tests, including yours, are passing.
    ```bash
    composer test
    ```
6.  **Commit Your Changes:** Write clear and concise commit messages.
7.  **Push to Your Fork:** Push your changes to your forked repository.
8.  **Submit a Pull Request:** Open a pull request from your branch to the `master` branch of the main repository. Provide a clear description of your changes in the pull request.

## Coding Standards

Please ensure your code adheres to the PSR-12 coding standard. You can use PHP CS Fixer to automatically format your code:

```bash
composer run-script format
```

## Reporting Bugs

If you encounter a bug, please open an issue on GitHub. Include the following information in your report:

-   A clear and descriptive title.
-   Steps to reproduce the bug.
-   The expected behavior.
-   The actual behavior.
-   Your PHP version and any relevant environment details.

## Suggesting Enhancements

If you have an idea for an enhancement, feel free to open an issue on GitHub to discuss it. Provide a clear explanation of the proposed enhancement and its benefits.

Thank you for contributing!
